gaps.reason: The escalate event has 2 effects. This release generates at most one effect per event, setting an optional datetime Field on the same record to the current time or nil.
gaps.consequence: `Expense#escalate!`, `#escalate`, and `#may_escalate?` are emitted as stubs that raise NotImplementedError until the event is written, and the State Machine examples that call them fail until then.
